dedupe_keys.name: plexos coad plexos class object attribute data manipulation tool

description: plexos-coad is a Python programming interface to the data sets of PLEXOS, a commercial production cost and power market simulator widely used for grid planning. It was released in 2017 by the National Renewable Energy Laboratory with Wes Jones, Clayton Barrows and Harry Sorensen as developers, because large grid simulation studies need scripted configuration and parallel execution to handle complexity and keep results consistent. The Class Object Attribute Data (COAD) interface reads and edits the PLEXOS data model, decomposes a data set in time so that parts can run in parallel without losing integrity, and recomposes the solution data sets produced by distributed runs of the simulator. Coverage is not tied to a place. The code is accessible on GitHub under a BSD 3-Clause licence from NREL at no cost. Caveats: it needs a licensed copy of PLEXOS to be useful, the README is minimal, and the last commit was in September 2021 with no tagged releases. Simulation uses are running large production cost and capacity studies in parallel and scripting scenario changes to PLEXOS models. Related records: model-egret is an open alternative for unit commitment and dispatch formulations.
